name: Eliezer
bio: Eliezer son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against King Jehoshaphat of Judah for allying himself with the wicked King Ahaziah of Israel to build a fleet of trading ships at Ezion Geber, declaring that the LORD would destroy what they had made; the ships were wrecked and never sailed to Tarshish (2 Chronicles 20:35-37).
